<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
## Overview

Keep direct filesystem KV offload caches topology-specific to prevent silent corruption when tensor-parallel size changes. Only certified canonical layouts are parallelism-agnostic; the replicated-layout exception remains separate.

## Claims

- Direct storage concatenates each worker's local layers, so changing TP changes byte offsets even when read sizes still match.
- Cross-TP direct-layout runs receive different persistent filenames.
- Same-TP reuse, canonical layouts, and replicated-layout controls retain their intended behavior.

## Validation

Validated on 2026-10-10 at published head `1c034ceeb4` and in a temporary merge with upstream `276fbcff2717bd934cfa37c8a2e4c391f3e7237b`. The published branch was not rebased.

```sh
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_config.py tests/v1/kv_offload/test_file_mapper.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_canonical_mapping.py -q
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_offload/cpu/test_canonical_layout.py -q -k 'not gpu_roundtrip and not cross_topology'
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --hook-stage manual --files vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/offloading/config.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_config.py
```

Published-head config, mapping, canonical, and filesystem suites pass **158 tests**. Current-upstream mapping/config/canonical controls pass **118 tests**; unchanged filesystem suites were not repeated. Filesystem validation used the real extension built from unchanged `csrc/fs_io.cpp`, resolving an older installed-extension mismatch. All applicable scoped hooks pass. Restoring the original predicate produces **2 direct-layout failures and 2 passing canonical controls**.

The previously recorded CPU filesystem reproduction uses real registration, shared mmap views, direct-copy descriptors, FileMapper, and batch I/O. TP1-to-TP2 and TP2-to-TP1 baseline reuse return **32,222 incorrect FP16 elements** with deterministic random data; same-TP controls have zero mismatches. The fix separates cross-TP filenames and preserves same-TP reuse. CPU copying substitutes for GPU DMA.

Real TP1↔TP2 model inference remains outstanding; only one GPU is available locally.

## Details

The current-upstream integration also removes a now-unused `single_group_spec` assignment after upstream changed its replicated-layout predicate.

Fresh overlap review found #55907 and #58196 concern physical-layout identity, a different dimension from TP topology. Neither replaces this fix.

Existing direct-layout caches become cold because their namespace changes; no files are deleted. Reverting restores ambiguous topology reuse. A separate filesystem root per topology is an operational workaround.

Upstream CI is blocked at contributor authorization. Only one GPU is available locally; TP1-to-TP2 model validation has not been run. AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, tests, and review.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

</details>

 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 """Tests for translating vLLM cache metadata to native offloading config."""
 
+from dataclasses import replace
 from typing import Any, cast
 from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
 
@@ -57,8 +58,7 @@ def _make_vllm_config(
     config.cache_config.prefix_cache_retention_interval = None
     config.model_config.model = "test-model"
     config.model_config.use_mla = False
-    # _full_attention_spec's heads at tp=1: the parallelism-agnostic gate
-    # requires the head shard to cover the model's KV heads exactly
+    # Matches _full_attention_spec's heads at tp=1.
     config.model_config.get_total_num_kv_heads.return_value = 4
     world_size = (
         tensor_parallel_size * pipeline_parallel_size * prefill_context_parallel_size
@@ -285,9 +285,11 @@ def _parallelism_agnostic(
     *,
     canonical: bool = False,
     v2: bool = False,
+    tensor_parallel_size: int = 1,
 ) -> bool:
     config = _make_vllm_config(
-        extra_config={"canonical_layout": True} if canonical else None
+        extra_config={"canonical_layout": True} if canonical else None,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
     )
     config.use_v2_model_runner = v2
     kv_cache_config = KVCacheConfig(
@@ -1104,8 +1106,20 @@ def test_replicated_layout_parallel_gate(kwargs: dict[str, Any], case: str):
     assert not _replicated_layout(_make_mla_kv_cache_config(), **kwargs), case
 
 
-def test_parallelism_agnostic_for_single_full_attention_group():
-    assert _parallelism_agnostic([KVCacheGroupSpec(["l0"], _full_attention_spec())])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tensor_parallel_size", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("canonical", [False, True])
+def test_head_sharded_attention_requires_canonical_layout_for_portability(
+    tensor_parallel_size: int, canonical: bool
+):
+    spec = replace(_full_attention_spec(), num_kv_heads=4 // tensor_parallel_size)
+    assert (
+        _parallelism_agnostic(
+            [KVCacheGroupSpec(["l0", "l1"], spec)],
+            canonical=canonical,
+            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
+        )
+        is canonical
+    )
 
 
 _SWA_SPEC = SlidingWindowSpec(

@@ -150,11 +150,6 @@ def build_offloading_config(
             _group_kv_bytes_per_block(group) for _, group in selected_groups
         )
 
-    single_group_spec = (
-        kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[0].kv_cache_spec
-        if len(kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups) == 1
-        else None
-    )
     replicated_layout = (
         vllm_config.model_config.use_mla
         and parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size > 1
@@ -172,25 +167,11 @@ def build_offloading_config(
 
     canonical_layout = bool(extra_config.get("canonical_layout", False))
 
-    # Only a single non-MLA full-attention group with genuinely head-sharded
-    # pages is parallelism-invariant: replicated latent or GQA heads,
-    # per-token-head scales, CP token sharding, and the V2 model runner's
-    # layout are all excluded.
-    is_parallelism_agnostic = (
-        not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner
-        and single_group_spec is not None
-        and isinstance(single_group_spec, FullAttentionSpec)
-        and not isinstance(single_group_spec, MLAAttentionSpec)
-        and single_group_spec.num_kv_heads * parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
-        == vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_kv_heads()
-        and not single_group_spec.kv_quant_mode.is_per_token_head
-        and parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size == 1
-        and parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size == 1
-    )
-    # Canonical pages are topology-free, so the gate widens to every config
-    # whose mappings derive portable, group by group; certification happens
-    # per layer at registration and create_worker fails closed on this flag.
-    if canonical_layout and not is_parallelism_agnostic:
+    # Direct pages concatenate each worker's layers before the next worker,
+    # so changing TP changes the byte layout even with head-sharded attention.
+    is_parallelism_agnostic = False
+    # Canonical mappings are also certified per layer at worker registration.
+    if canonical_layout:
         tp_size = parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
         total_kv_heads = vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_kv_heads()
